sections.title: Animal Companions
sections.note: You meet all three, but your flute decides your partner and the shape of Natzu. A Linked Game keeps the same partner.

items.name: Win back Ricky's Gloves
items.howTo: Ricky, on Holodrum Plain, lost his boxing gloves to Blaino. Pay Blaino 10 Rupees and knock him out of the ring, using no items or rings.
items.notes: Breaking his rules raises the fee for the next match.

items.name: Choose a partner
items.howTo: Before you return Ricky's gloves, buy a Strange Flute at the Horon Village Shop (150 Rupees) for Moosh, or win one at the Subrosian Dance Hall for Dimitri. With neither, Ricky gives you Ricky's Flute.
items.notes: A Strange Flute's owner meets you in Spool Swamp: Moblins offer to sell Dimitri (50 Rupees, then 30 more), or Moblins attack Moosh and you beat them. Both Strange Flutes disappear once you help Ricky.

items.name: Ricky
items.howTo: Give Ricky his gloves; he lets you ride in his pouch to Spool Swamp, jumping the holes on the way.
items.notes: Punches, and charges a tornado punch by holding A. He won't go into Sunken City.

items.name: Cross Natzu
items.howTo: Call your partner to cross Natzu, between Holodrum Plain and Sunken City: Natzu Prairie for Ricky's jumps, Natzu River for Dimitri's swimming, Natzu Wasteland for Moosh's flying.
items.notes: Always spring. Whatever its shape, it has the same three caves: a Fairy Fountain, a Deku Scrub and a 50-Rupee chest. The Great Moblin's Keep is at its east end.

items.name: Dimitri
items.howTo: If he isn't your partner, give the 'Safety Patrol' kids harassing him all your Bombs. He swims you up the waterfalls to the Master Diver.
items.notes: He leaves after you get the Zora's Flippers. If he is your partner, just call him into the city.

items.name: Moosh
items.howTo: In spring, take a Flying Cucco up to the eastern summit for a Spring Banana and feed Moosh. He flies you over the pits on Goron Mountain to the Dragon Key.
items.notes: You meet him here whoever your partner is.
